title: feat(oppcan): n=0 cells never form
science: Bounded_theorem note, no probe cell. Forcing negative against the blocker 'any occupied neighbor forms': on a 3-site line with BOTH ends locked the center has n_x=0 and the step is the identity -- opposite occupied neighbors CANCEL. So formation under L0 is a signed DIFFERENCE, not an OR/monotone function of occupied neighbors, which means the update is not monotone in occupancy and a fully surrounded site can be permanently frozen. Census: exactly 8 of the 64 six-bit cells have k=0. This is the structural reason the campaign's later 'opposite-lock (nsopp)' seeds behave as they do. 12/12 runner PASS.
